data.one_liner: Monitor and control system volume values in real-time on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to get the current system volume, max volume, and platform version, set the system volume, and listen to real-time volume changes.
use_when: You need to track system volume changes in real-time.
Your media or custom audio app needs to programmatically set the device volume.
avoid_when: You are building for desktop or web platforms, as this plugin only supports iOS and Android.
strengths: Provides both a listener widget and static methods for volume control.
Unifies the volume range for Android and iOS between 0.0 and 1.0.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only iOS and Android).
Some features like hiding the volume view are strictly iOS-only.
data.setup_notes: No extra native setup steps or permissions are documented.
